global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text and highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary support for this variation: honey pine floor #C98E4F, kraft cardboard #B98A5A and beige trousers #D8C7AE.
global_identity.visual_style: Real smartphone photo, unedited look, natural daylight, the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo; text only as a story-style caption and a slim bottom band.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Honest and everyday: just got home from the office, the package just arrived.
global_identity.graphic_language: Instagram-story caption on a white rounded box, a slim plum bottom band with a bordered badge; everything else is the raw photo.
global_identity.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; secondary texts in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold / Bold look).

creative_objective: Feel like a real post from an office worker: she sits on her floor after work, looks down at her thin legs lost inside loose trousers, and the package she just received at home sits beside her with the bottle on top. The caption and the band answer the trust objection: you receive it at home, you pay there, and it has its INVIMA registration.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the legs in loose trousers (the pain), 2) the story caption headline, 3) the bottle on the open delivery box, 4) the bottom band with 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' and the badge.
art_direction.composition_style: Point-of-view shot looking down along her own legs stretched forward on the floor, legs centered and running from the bottom edge toward the top; floorboards run vertically; the box with the bottle sits to the right of her shins.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Caption in the top floor zone, clear of the feet; box and bottle in the right third; slim band at the very bottom.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft natural daylight from a window at the top left, gentle shadows to the lower right, real phone depth of field (everything mostly sharp, floor slightly softer far away).
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 native smartphone photo, unedited UGC look, slight phone wide-angle (about 26 mm equivalent), point-of-view from her eyes looking down at about 50 degrees along her own legs, taken at home right after work. BACKGROUND everywhere: worn honey pine wooden floorboards #C98E4F running vertically, with dark knots, small gaps between boards and a soft satin sheen, soft natural daylight from a window at the top left, gentle shadows falling to the lower right. TOP ZONE (0–15% height): bare floor; on it, an Instagram-story-style caption centered, 2 lines, each line on its own white #FFFFFF rounded box (like the native story text tool), black #0E0E10 Montserrat ExtraBold uppercase, about 5% of the canvas height; the word 'CASA' in hot fuchsia #E6177F. MIDDLE ZONE (15–88% height). CENTER (22–70% width): her two legs stretched forward on the floor, slightly apart, running from the bottom of the frame (knees) up to her bare feet near 18% height, toes up, real skin on the feet and ankles with visible pores, fine creases and slight redness at the toes, light-brown Colombian skin tone. She wears loose high-waisted beige #D8C7AE tailored office trousers in a matte crepe fabric with a center crease: the fabric is clearly too wide for her thin legs, sagging into big empty folds at the thighs and bunching in loose wrinkles at the knees and ankles; one of her hands enters from the bottom left and pinches a big fold of excess fabric at the thigh, pulling it up to show how much spare cloth there is. The problem must read immediately: thin legs lost inside baggy trousers. RIGHT (68–96% width, 38–80% height): an opened kraft cardboard delivery box #B98A5A with its flaps open and a strip of torn clear tape, a little crinkled pink tissue paper inside, no logos and no legible shipping label; standing on top of the box, the real product bottle upright, label facing her and the camera, about 26% of the canvas height, sharp, with a soft contact shadow. PRODUCT: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. Always closed with its cap on; no loose capsules; the label reads the right way round, never mirrored. LEFT edge (0–20% width): only floor, her work tote bag strap barely entering the frame. BOTTOM ZONE (88–100% height): a full-width dark plum #2B1226 band: left, white Montserrat Black uppercase 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' with a small white hand-and-coin line icon; right, a rounded badge with a solid 3 px hot-fuchsia border and a small white shield line icon containing the registration text in white Poppins Bold uppercase on two lines. Apart from the caption and the band, the image must look like a raw phone photo. All texts crisp, spelled exactly with correct accents, nothing else written anywhere.

mandatory_visual_elements: Point-of-view phone photo of her own legs on a honey wooden floor (more than 25% of the canvas): thin legs inside loose beige office trousers, a hand pinching a big fold of excess fabric at the thigh
Opened kraft delivery box without logos to the right of her shins, with the real closed bottle standing on it, label readable
Two white Instagram-story caption boxes at the top
Dark plum bottom band with 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' and a bordered registration badge
final_generation_exclusions: No capsules or pills anywhere; no open bottle; no other brand; no courier logo or legible shipping label
No prices, percentages, ratings, testimonials or 'envío gratis'
No logos; never write the words 'AGREGAR' or 'LOGO Y SELLO DE'
No studio look, no glossy retouching, no fashion styling
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
Do not add prices, extra badges, benefit lists, ratings, testimonials, discount labels or extra claims beyond the listed caption, band and badge.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. Only true trust facts (cash on delivery and the INVIMA registration supplied by the user); the problem is shown through clothing fit, without naming body defects or promising results.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
